views.name: vw_trazabilidad_categories
views.definition: select `c`.`ID` AS `id`,`c`.`name` AS `name`,`c`.`description` AS `description`,`c`.`sup_id_category` AS `sup_id_category`,`c`.`status` AS `status`,`c`.`creation_date` AS `creation_date`,`c`.`last_update` AS `last_update`,`l`.`db_user` AS `performed_by`,coalesce(group_concat(distinct `re`.`FROM_USER` order by `re`.`FROM_USER` ASC separator ', '),'Sin rol') AS `roles`,`l`.`table_operation` AS `operation`,`l`.`operation_description` AS `operation_description`,`l`.`operation_date` AS `operation_date`,`l`.`operation_status` AS `operation_status` from ((`tbc_categories` `c` left join `tb_logs` `l` on((`l`.`table_name` = 'tb_categories'))) left join `mysql`.`role_edges` `re` on((`re`.`TO_USER` = substring_index(`l`.`db_user`,'@',1)))) group by `c`.`ID`,`c`.`name`,`c`.`description`,`c`.`sup_id_category`,`c`.`status`,`c`.`creation_date`,`c`.`last_update`,`l`.`db_user`,`l`.`table_operation`,`l`.`operation_description`,`l`.`operation_date`,`l`.`operation_status`

views.name: vw_trazabilidad_productos
views.definition: select `p`.`ID` AS `id`,`p`.`SKU` AS `sku`,`p`.`name` AS `name`,`p`.`description` AS `description`,`p`.`current_price` AS `current_price`,`p`.`current_stock` AS `current_stock`,`p`.`status` AS `status`,`b`.`db_user` AS `user_operation`,coalesce(group_concat(distinct `re`.`FROM_USER` order by `re`.`FROM_USER` ASC separator ', '),'Sin rol') AS `roles`,`b`.`table_operation` AS `operation`,`b`.`operation_description` AS `operation_description`,`b`.`operation_date` AS `operation_date`,`b`.`operation_status` AS `operation_status` from ((`tb_products` `p` join `tb_logs` `b` on(((`b`.`table_name` = 'tb_products') and (`b`.`operation_description` like concat('%SKU: ',`p`.`SKU`,'%'))))) left join `mysql`.`role_edges` `re` on((`re`.`TO_USER` = substring_index(`b`.`db_user`,'@',1)))) group by `p`.`ID`,`p`.`SKU`,`p`.`name`,`p`.`description`,`p`.`current_price`,`p`.`current_stock`,`p`.`status`,`b`.`db_user`,`b`.`table_operation`,`b`.`operation_description`,`b`.`operation_date`,`b`.`operation_status`

views.name: vw_trazabilidad_products_categories
views.definition: select `pc`.`category_ID` AS `category_id`,`pc`.`product_ID` AS `product_id`,`pc`.`status` AS `status`,`pc`.`creation_date` AS `creation_date`,`pc`.`last_update` AS `last_update`,`l`.`db_user` AS `performed_by`,coalesce(group_concat(distinct `re`.`FROM_USER` order by `re`.`FROM_USER` ASC separator ', '),'Sin rol') AS `roles`,`l`.`table_operation` AS `operation`,`l`.`operation_description` AS `operation_description`,`l`.`operation_date` AS `operation_date`,`l`.`operation_status` AS `operation_status` from ((`tbd_products_categories` `pc` left join `tb_logs` `l` on((`l`.`table_name` = 'tbd_products_categories'))) left join `mysql`.`role_edges` `re` on((`re`.`TO_USER` = substring_index(`l`.`db_user`,'@',1)))) group by `pc`.`category_ID`,`pc`.`product_ID`,`pc`.`status`,`pc`.`creation_date`,`pc`.`last_update`,`l`.`db_user`,`l`.`table_operation`,`l`.`operation_description`,`l`.`operation_date`,`l`.`operation_status`

views.name: vw_trazabilidad_users
views.definition: select `u`.`ID` AS `id`,`u`.`email` AS `email`,`u`.`nick` AS `nick`,`u`.`creation_date` AS `creation_date`,`u`.`last_update` AS `last_update`,`u`.`last_login` AS `last_login`,`u`.`status` AS `status`,`l`.`db_user` AS `performed_by`,coalesce(group_concat(distinct `re`.`FROM_USER` order by `re`.`FROM_USER` ASC separator ', '),'Sin rol') AS `roles`,`l`.`table_operation` AS `operation`,`l`.`operation_description` AS `operation_description`,`l`.`operation_date` AS `operation_date`,`l`.`operation_status` AS `operation_status` from ((`tb_users` `u` left join `tb_logs` `l` on(((`l`.`table_name` = 'tb_users') and (`l`.`db_user` = `u`.`email`)))) left join `mysql`.`role_edges` `re` on((`re`.`TO_USER` = substring_index(`l`.`db_user`,'@',1)))) group by `u`.`ID`,`u`.`email`,`u`.`nick`,`u`.`creation_date`,`u`.`last_update`,`u`.`last_login`,`u`.`status`,`l`.`db_user`,`l`.`table_operation`,`l`.`operation_description`,`l`.`operation_date`,`l`.`operation_status`

descriptions.tb_buyer_orders: Pedidos colocados por usuarios que actúan como compradores/vendedores según seller_ID.
descriptions.tb_carts: Carritos asociados a una cuenta de usuario.
descriptions.tb_logs: Registro de operaciones descritas en la aplicación.
descriptions.tb_products: Catálogo de productos, precios y existencias.
descriptions.tb_users: Cuentas de usuario y sus datos de acceso.
descriptions.tbc_categories: Categorías del catálogo, con posible jerarquía.
descriptions.tbc_payment_methods: Tipos de método de pago disponibles.
descriptions.tbd_carts_items: Productos y cantidades asociados a carritos.
descriptions.tbd_order_items: Detalle de productos incluidos en pedidos.
descriptions.tbd_produtcs_users_providers: Asociación de productos con usuarios proveedores y tipo de propiedad (nombre original conservado).

descriptions.tbd_users_wishlist_products: Productos guardados por usuarios en una lista de deseos.
